videos.title: Nanami: Storm | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Liv: Eclipse". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nanami: Storm is the starter Tank character of the Gray Raven squad, debuted in December 5, 2019. As a B-Rank Physical Tank, she excels at breaking enemy defenses (Yellow Bars) and providing protection for the team.

🔴 Utility: Her kit focuses on defense reduction and crowd control. She is vital for shredding enemy armor, allowing your DPS characters to deal significantly more damage.
🔴 Core Passive (Ex-Axe Storm): By triggering any 3-Ping followed immediately by at least 1-Yellow Ping orb, Nanami performs a powerful spinning attack. This maneuver deals massive Physical damage and greatly increases her damage reduction, allowing her to stay in the fray while disrupting enemy formations.

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Watanabe: Astral". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Watanabe: Astral is an A-Rank frame for Watanabe that debuted on February 6, 2020. As an A-Rank Dark Attacker, he is widely celebrated for his incredible damage-to-cost ratio, often performing at the level of S-Rank characters when properly invested.

🔴 Utility: Astral is a master of sustained pressure. His kit allows him to teleport and shadow-step around enemies, making it easy to stay in their blind spots while maintaining a constant barrage of Dark elemental damage.'
🔴 Core Passive (Shadow Flash): By triggering any 3-Ping followed immediately by a Red Ping, Watanabe enters an enhanced state. During this time, his basic attacks are infused with Dark energy, and he periodically summons shadow clones to strike the target, significantly increasing his overall DPS and elemental output.

videos.title: Alisa: Echo | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Alisa: Echo". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Alisa: Echo is an S-Rank frame for Alisa that debuted on June 8, 2023. As a premier S-Rank Physical Amplifier, she acts as the ultimate cornerstone for physical teams, flawlessly blending team-wide offensive buffs and consistent healing with devastating bow attacks.

🔴 Utility: Alisa provides critical, high-value attribute boosts to physical squads, significantly multiplying the critical hit rates and raw damage of her allies. Her long-range archery allows her to safely apply defense-shredding debuffs via her QTE, making her an indispensable asset for maximizing the team's burst windows.

🔴 Core Passive (Duet Harmony): Triggering 3-Pings allows Alisa to summon her giant mechanical puppet, Seraph, to the battlefield to fight alongside her. Together, they execute synchronized dual attacks that pull enemies into a centralized point while dropping their Physical Resistance. Her Signature Move stops the stage timer completely, letting her fire a cataclysmic barrage of light arrows that rain down for massive, screen-clearing AoE Physical damage.

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Bridget: Ardeo". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bridget: Ardeo is an A-Rank frame for Bridget that debuted on March 24, 2024. Serving as a highly reliable A-Rank Fire Tank, she brings incredible defensive frontline utility and shield-breaking power to Fire squads, making her an exceptional free-to-play asset.

🔴 Utility: Bridget specializes in close-quarters crowd containment and high-stagger impact. Armed with her heavy shield and tactical weapon, her QTE and active strikes aggressively draw scattered enemies into a tight cluster while applying a useful Fire Resistance debuff to boost the squad's total damage.

🔴 Core Passive (Blazing Bastion): Triggering 3-Pings charges her defensive kinetic gauge. Once filled, holding the basic attack button puts Bridget into a fortified Shield Stance that absorbs incoming damage and grants total stagger immunity. Successfully blocking an attack triggers a powerful automated counter-strike, unleashing an explosive fire shockwave that breaks enemy super armor and inflicts a massive stun effect.

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Lucia: Pyroath". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lucia: Pyroath is an S-Rank frame for Lucia that debuted on July 11, 2024. As a premier S-Rank Fire Attacker, she infuses the Fire team with raw, unstoppable destructive force, wielding a massive, blazing greatsword to cleave through enemy formations.

🔴 Utility: Lucia: Pyroath dominates the field with wide, sweeping AoE strikes and relentless close-range pressure. Her attack animations provide immense stagger resist and crowd-control properties, allowing her to continuously gather enemies while heating them up for massive multipliers.

🔴 Core Passive (Blazing Forge): Consuming 3-Pings charges her weapon's thermal core. Once her gauge fills completely, holding down the basic attack button prompts her to slam her greatsword down, entering an enhanced Overheat State. In this stance, her blade extends with raw plasma fire, transforming all standard basic attacks into heavy kinetic shockwaves that completely ignore enemy defensive parameters and shred Fire Resistance.

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

🔴 Utility: Bianca is designed for hyper-optimal field control and rapid wave clearing as your primary Dark damage dealer, effectively succeeding older frames like Lamia. Her playstyle is extremely fluid, allowing players to swap her combat states on the fly to tailor her elemental attacks and off-field properties directly to the combat environment.

🔴 Core Passive (Eventide & Dawnlight Forms): Bianca shifts seamlessly between two distinct battle stances:Twilight / Eventide Form: In this form, she deals raw 100% Dark elemental damage and commands only Red and Blue Orbs. Holding down her dodge button activates her localized Abyssal Domain, pulling in enemies and filling her central gauge while generating Red Orbs to unleash high-impact continuous slash combinations.Radiance / Dawnlight Form: Swapping states transitions her to command Yellow and Blue Orbs, transforming her damage profile to deal specialized Glow / Radiance damage. Holding down her dodge button automatically consumes these orbs to instantly fully charge her core gauge. Once fully charged, holding down the basic attack button unleashes her devastating core passive, consuming the gauge to hyper-charge her second Signature Move to its maximum damage multipliers

videos.title: Teddy: Spectre | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Teddy: Spectre". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Teddy: Spectre is an S-Rank frame for Teddy that debuted on December 23, 2025. Stepping out of her standard utility style, she is the premier, generation-defining S-Rank Ice Amplifier designed to pack incredible healing and squad-wide offensive multipliers.

🔴 Utility: Teddy acts as the absolute cornerstone buffer and sub-DPS for high-tier Ice squads. In addition to her essential healing, her class trait heavily elevates elemental damage output, seamlessly slotting into optimal rotations with characters like Wanshi: Lucid Dreamer. She can also trigger the specialized Raydiance / Radiant effect to drop concentrated plasma bursts on targets for supplementary damage bursts.

🔴 Core Passive (Data Domain): Base combat loops restrict her action parameters exclusively to unique White Orbs. Pinging these coordinates records colored values that charge up her signature parameters. Activating her Signature Move expands the battlefield into her digital Data Domain, forcing a massive spatial shift that automatically clusters targets together while dropping their Ice Resistance. While in this domain, her movement shifts to a hyper-fluid, action-game rhythm using her Digital Warboots to string high-multiplier strikes.

videos.title: Rosetta: Arete | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Rosetta: Arete". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rosetta: Arete is an S-Rank frame for Rosetta that debuted on February 3, 2026 in the Withering Crown patch. Breaking her traditional tank archetype, she introduces the brand-new Breaker class and acts as a specialized 100% Dark elemental damage dealer.

🔴 Utility: Codenamed "Malkuth," Arete can freely switch between her human and robotic centaur forms to launch attacks that break normal power limits. Her primary role is a dedicated shield-breaker and defense shredder, rapidly lowering enemy Dark Resistance to set up aggressive, tempo-driven combat loops for your main Dark damage dealers.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her mechanics requires a color-stacking gray-scale loop. Pinging two Red Orbs followed by a held basic attack charges her core gauge to build a stack. Swapping over to tap Blue Orbs and holding basic attack adds her second stack, fully enabling her to tap her signature shift into Centaur Form. While in Centaur Form, she triggers the specialized Ultima Slash effect—modifying her computational output to drop a cataclysmic, armor-shattering dark cavalry charge across the field.

videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Nirvatia: Dirge". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nirvatia: Dirge is an S-Rank frame for Nirvatia that debuted on March 17, 2026 in the Chinese server release. She enters the roster as a specialized Physical Support / Amplifier character designed to anchor high-tier physical team compositions.

🔴 Utility: Nirvatia: Dirge excels at continuous field control and burst-window amplification. Her primary utility centers on her ability to generate a localized gravity well upon entering the field, pulling in smaller mobs and keeping them grouped. Simultaneously, her passive aura applies a persistent physical defense reduction to all affected targets, significantly lowering the barrier for your primary physical damage dealers to burst through tough armor pools.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation requires executing a strict rhythmic orb-ping sequence. Pinging any 3-Orb combination triggers her "Grave Melody" stance, causing her next basic attack to transform into a sweeping scythe strike that builds her internal Requiem Gauge. Once the gauge is filled to maximum, a held basic attack consumes all energy to execute her Dirge Finale. This high-impact finisher bursts the gravity well, deals massive physical damage, and instantly triggers the QTE of your off-field team members to maximize rotation speed.If

videos.description:
A showcase of Nanally's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

I think overall, all of Nanally's animations are quite even in quality, with the best being her basic and charged attacks, of course. I like how she uses a mix of kicks and punches, both feeling just as strong as the other. I also really like how you can really feel the oomph coming out of Nanally's basic attacks (the amazing sound design is also a big factor of it), her charged attacks amplifying that oomph times TEN, with each hit feeling like you're hitting the enemies with trucks. Her weakest link only being her Redirect Skill, which still feels really impactful cuz the effects make up for the weird animation. The little animations she does after each attack are also really cute and add to her personality. 10/10 for me.

videos.title: Hathor Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Hathor's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

As someone who uses her as a burst DPS, I did NOT expect her to attack using her legs (that is not a complaint in any way). Her basic attacks are probably my favorite part of her kit animation-wise, as I like the way they feel so floaty and strong at the same time, and each one of them feel equally as good as the other. Her Redirect Skill, charged attack, and plunge attack feel a little weak in comparison, although I do like how she has a unique plunge attack (animation-wise tho, it also feels weak). Her ultimate is just fine, tho I feel they could've done a bit more with it. One thing I didn't know was that she could ride motorcycles herself, until I someone else do it, which I think is a really cool unique feature of hers (and I hope that gets extended to more characters in the future). 7/10 for me.

videos.title: Hotori Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Hotori's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Since Hotori is an ultimate-focused character, it's only natural for her to have the best ultimate animations (including the ultimate attacks) in the game. One thing I really appreciate is how even her ultimate attacks each have their own sheathing animation (and BOY am I glad her ultimate recharges over time so I didn't have to farm energy over and over again to showcase each one). It's something they didn't HAVE to do, but it really shows how much effort they put into each character's animations. They even added a PLUNGE attack for her ultimate, even though no one would even THINK of plunging during it (I fogor to showcase it cuz of that mb). The rest of her animations are just fine for me, but I also do like the way she floats with her umbrella after her basic attacks, which are just nice to look at. 7/10 for me.

Guess I'm a showcase channel now.
